messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=inference-eu-01 - symptom=5xx spike - severity=high - incident=INC-2027. Auto-escalation to rotation group. See /incidents/INC-2027 for details

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident INC-2027 assigned to rotation: lia (oncall) - use /claim to acknowledge. If no ack in 2m, will escalate.

lia (oncall): acked. I'm on it. quick check: is this widespread or a single region?

alex (sre): Seeing 5xx across EU region, error class: "model-runtime-timeout" and some OOMs on gpu-pool-3b. Spike started ~10:02 UTC, request rate ~3x baseline.

maya (infra): Confirmed. Autoscaler didn't scale last 4m due to GC pause on controller leader. I'm restarting controller leader now.

sam (ml): Noted that a new qkv-quantization variant rolled out last night to some hosts. Could be memory regression. Rolling back that variant on a subset could be quick.

jordan (support): Heads-up: two customers have submitted support tickets reporting failed completions. One is billing-critical. Need ETA to update them.

lia (oncall): Thanks. Plan: (1) hold traffic steering to inference-eu-01, (2) scale fallback cluster inference-eu-fallback by +3 pods, (3) attempt quick rollback of quant variant on a canary subset. Maya, can you scale fallback now? Alex, work rollback with Sam. Jordan, I'll ping customers.

maya (infra): Scaling fallback: executing:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-eu-fallback
kubectl scale deployment inference-eu-fallback --replicas=6 -n inference
```

maya (infra): Pods coming up. 3/6 ready, CPU stable so far.

alex (sre): Running rollback on canary hosts: switching model-profile from qkv-quant-v2 -> qkv-quant-v1 on hostgroup eu-canary-1. Command:
```
redwoodctl models set-profile --model rdx-7b --profile qkv-quant-v1 --hosts eu-canary-1
```

alex (sre): Rollback applied to canary. Monitoring latency and 5xx.

lia (oncall): Update customers: "We've detected elevated 5xx errors in EU inference. We're actively mitigating by routing traffic to fallback and rolling back a recent runtime profile. Expect reduced errors within 10-15 minutes. We'll update again in 10." jordan, please send.

jordan (support): Sent initial update to affected customers. Added INC-2027 link and status.

sam (ml): Canary telemetry shows 5xx rate down 60% on rolled-back hosts, latency steady. Suggest expanding rollback to additional hostgroups if fallback holds.

maya (infra): Autoscaler leader restart completed. It reconciled and started scaling decisions. Controller logs showed a GC spike at 10:01 likely due to large config churn from last night's rollout.

lia (oncall): Good. Next: expand rollback to eu-canary-2 and eu-canary-3, then gradually to primary if stable. Alex, coordinate. Maya, keep fallback capacity until primary healthy. Jordan hold on next customer msg until we confirm broader improvement.

alex (sre): Expanding rollback now. Rolling groups: eu-canary-2 -> eu-primary-a -> eu-primary-b. Doing eu-canary-2...

pagerbot: Incident INC-2027 acknowledged by lia (oncall). PagerDuty notes: acknowledged at 10:05 UTC. Escalation paused.

alex (sre): eu-canary-2 rollback finished. 5xx down 70% across canaries. Applying to eu-primary-a (staggered)

maya (infra): Fallback cluster handling ~30% of EU traffic, no errors from fallback. Network and egress are OK.

lia (oncall): Quick risk check: any data-loss risk from reverting model-profile? Sam?

sam (ml): No data loss. It's model execution profile only. Some latency variance expected but acceptable. Quality unchanged.

jordan (support): Customer update drafted: "Mitigation in progress - rolling back runtime profile and shifting traffic to fallback. Expect improvement within 10-20 minutes; we'll follow up as the incident progresses." Ready to send on go.

alex (sre): eu-primary-a rollback done, eu-primary-b starting. Monitoring shows error rates decreasing cluster-wide.

lia (oncall): Nice. T-minus 8m to target. If error rate continues to drop, we can start gradual traffic shift off fallback back to primary in 20m.

sam (ml): Also flagged a postmortem item: guardrail to prevent autoscaler GC pauses and better rollout canary checks on profile memory usage.

pagerbot: Reminder: If you need a bridge, run `/bridge create INC-2027` - a temporary zoom/join link will be posted.

alex (sre): eu-primary-b rollback complete. Aggregated 5xx drop -> 85% reduction vs peak. Latency normalizing.

maya (infra): Scaling down fallback once we confirm traffic shift is safe. I'll prepare an update plan: 10% shift increments every 3m.

lia (oncall): Let's do a controlled shift: 10% back to primary every 3 minutes, watch errors. If 5xx < baseline+10% continue. Maya, start first shift. Jordan on standby to message customers after first successful shift.

maya (infra): Initiating 10% shift back to primary.
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --from inference-eu-fallback --to inference-eu-primary --percent 10
```

maya (infra): First 10% step complete. No error spike.

lia (oncall): Good. Proceeding with next step in 3m. Jordan send the follow-up message: "Errors subsiding; we are shifting traffic back to primary in controlled steps."

jordan (support): Sent. Customers acknowledged, appreciate the proactive updates.

lia (oncall): After 3 steps (30%) errors still stable. Continue until 100%. We'll keep incident open until we complete verification and artifact collection for postmortem.

sam (ml): Recording incident tags: root_cause_suspected=runtime-profile-memory-regression, mitigations=rollback+fallback+autoscaler-restart. Adding new evals to CI for profile memory tests.

alex (sre): Creating short log bundle and heap snapshots for the affected hosts and uploading to /incidents/INC-2027/artifacts.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2027 status -> mitigated: false, active hosts stable, errors decreasing. Next auto-check in 10m.

lia (oncall): Marking current status: mitg in progress, customer impact limited to failed completions earlier, now recovering. Will update final closure when traffic fully on primary and artifacts uploaded.

jordan (support): I'll keep customers updated and close tickets once we have full recovery confirmation.

maya (infra): Fallback reduced to 40% as of last shift. No regressions.

alex (sre): Logs uploaded. Will follow-up with timeline and remediation steps in the postmortem draft.

lia (oncall): Thanks everyone. Paging notes for handoff: if incident persists beyond my shift, please ping oncall-rotation for takeover and reference INC-2027. I'll leave a quick runbook note in /incidents/INC-2027.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2027: last update 10:14 UTC by lia (oncall). Escalation window extended.

lia (oncall): closing loop for now — monitoring until fully resolved. :white_check_mark:
